title: Local search dialog: a combobox over the page's own list
intent: Search and filter a long page without leaving it
summary: 48 synthetic release notes indexed once from the served DOM; a header button, `/` or Ctrl/Cmd+K (ignored in text fields) opens a native `<dialog>` (`showModal()`) whose `role="combobox"` input controls a `listbox`: every query word must start a word of the note (case and accents folded), ranked title 3, section and tags 2, summary 1, matches wrapped in `<mark>` built as nodes; six `aria-pressed` toggles narrow the set; a narrowed list lights its first option, arrows move `aria-activedescendant`, Enter or a click follows to the note's heading with a `1.6 s` tint; a polite status announces the count `450 ms` after the last change; the open is a `240 ms` fade with a 12 px rise (full), a `160 ms` fade (reduced) or a cut (static), new results fade and rise 4 px over `160 ms` in the full tier only, and panel and backdrop fade out together over `80 ms`
variants: a dialog over a release's notes, section toggles (this, default)
an inline combobox in the header that expands into the same listbox, for a page with fewer than about twenty items
a version switcher beside it: a native `<select>` of editions whose change navigates, with the search scoped to the edition shown
